'''Ed Wearn''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Pittsburgh Comicon tournament]] on 29 April 2000 with ISB with Den of Thieves, according to Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d624">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-pittsburgh-comicon-4-29-00d624/ pittsburgh-comicon-4-29-00], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 29 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-pittsburgh-comicon-4-29-00d624/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
